title: fix(components): select-all, the row checkboxes and the row numbers share one centre line (objectui#13293)
body:
Fixes #13293

## What

With selection and row numbers both on, the leading column drew three things on three different vertical lines:

- the row checkbox, centred over the whole cell (`row-select` is `absolute inset-0 justify-center`);
- the row number, centred over the cell's content box (`text-center`);
- the header's select-all, left-aligned after `px-3`.

The base `TableCell`/`TableHead` drops the right padding of any cell holding a checkbox (`[&:has([role=checkbox])]:pr-0`), so the content box is 12px/0 and its centre sits 6px right of the cell's.

Now, when `showRowNumbers` is on, the leading header and body cells use `px-0` and select-all is wrapped in a `flex justify-center` (`data-slot="select-all"`). Without row numbers nothing changes: everything stays at the cell start with `px-3`.

Measured in Chromium (leading cell 141px wide, frozen column on):

| | header select-all | row checkbox | row number |
|---|---|---|---|
| before | x=21 | x=71.7 | x=77.7 |
| after | x=71.7 | x=71.7 | x=71.7 |
| no row numbers (unchanged) | x=21 | x=21 | — |

Also: puts `isPinnedRightColumn`'s docblock back above it. The objectui#13188 helper had been inserted between them (acceptance note (1) on that card). No code change.

## Tests

New `data-table-selectAllAlign-13293.test.tsx`: select-all is centred exactly when the rows are, and the leading cells drop their side padding exactly then (both `showRowNumbers` values). Both cases fail without the fix. All 28 `data-table*` test files pass.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
